caption.text:
Rekaman video beredar di media sosial, memperlihatkan kepanikan di restoran Mie Gacoan, Matraman, Jakarta Pusat, Senin (27/7/2026) dini hari.

Kepanikan itu imbas adanya konflik sekelompok warga di Jalan Tambak. Polisi memberikan penjelasannya.

#matraman #konflik #detiknews
caption.text_translation:
Video footage circulating on social media, showing panic at Mie Gacoan restaurant, Matraman, Central Jakarta, Monday (27/7/2026) early morning.

Panic is a reflection of the conflict of a group of citizens in Jalan Tambak. The police are providing the explanation.

 #matraman #konflik #detiknews
